name: 911 Carrera
tagline: The benchmark, refined for six decades.
description: The 992.2-generation 911 Carrera keeps the rear-mounted flat-six and the silhouette that has defined the sports car since 1963, now with a sharper twin-turbo 3.0-litre engine and a fully digital cockpit.

name: 458 Spider
tagline: Maranello's naturally aspirated V8, roof down.
description: Designed by Pininfarina and powered by a 9,000 rpm 4.5-litre V8, the 458 is widely considered one of the greatest mid-engined Ferraris ever built. The Spider adds a folding aluminium hard-top that stows in 14 seconds. This is a fully detailed, real-scale 3D model including its cabin.

name: Huracán EVO
tagline: A naturally aspirated V10 with a wedge-shaped soul.
description: Sharp hexagonal design, all-wheel drive and a 5.2-litre V10 that revs past 8,000 rpm. The Huracán EVO pairs drama with a predictive dynamics system that thinks a step ahead of the driver.

name: M4 Competition
tagline: Six cylinders, two doors, zero compromise.
description: M TwinPower Turbo inline-six, M xDrive all-wheel drive with a rear-biased 2WD mode, and a cockpit built around the curved display. A track-capable coupé that still does the daily commute.

modelCredit.title: 2026 BMW M4 Competition
modelCredit.author: Maroi Mister Let Me Think Official 3D Studio

name: AMG G 63
tagline: A military-grade silhouette with a hand-built V8.
description: Barely changed in shape since 1979, the G-Class is pure statement. The AMG G 63 adds a hand-built 4.0-litre biturbo V8 with mild-hybrid assist, three locking differentials and a cabin of quilted leather.

name: Range Rover
tagline: Reductive design. Unmatched composure.
description: The fifth-generation Range Rover strips the design back to a single clean volume with a floating roof and hidden lighting, hiding all-terrain ability under serene luxury. Locally assembled in India since 2024.

name: Model Y
tagline: The world's best-selling EV, now in India.
description: The refreshed Model Y brings a full-width light bar, a quieter cabin and ventilated seats. Launched in India in 2025 in Rear-Wheel Drive and Long Range RWD versions.

name: Thar ROXX
tagline: Five doors. Same unstoppable attitude.
description: The five-door Thar ROXX keeps the boxy, go-anywhere character of the original and adds space for the family, a panoramic sunroof, ADAS and a new 4XPLOR 4x4 system.

name: Fortuner
tagline: India's favourite full-size SUV.
description: A body-on-frame, seven-seat SUV famous for durability and resale value. The 2.8-litre diesel with 4x4 remains the enthusiast's pick, alongside the sportier GR-S and Legender variants.

name: Creta
tagline: The compact SUV that set the standard.
description: Hyundai's best-seller with a full-width LED light bar, a dual 10.25-inch display layout and three engines, including a 160 PS turbo petrol with a 7-speed DCT.

name: Nexon EV
tagline: India's electric SUV pioneer.
description: Tata's Nexon EV popularised electric cars in India. The 45 kWh version offers a claimed 489 km range, V2L and V2V charging, and a sharp split-headlamp design with connected LED bars.

name: Swift
tagline: The hatchback India grew up with.
description: The fourth-generation Swift brings a new 1.2-litre Z-series three-cylinder engine with class-leading efficiency, a sportier stance and a floating 9-inch touchscreen.

name: Sierra
tagline: The 90s icon, reborn with its wrap-around glasshouse.
description: Tata's revived Sierra keeps the original's upright stance and signature curved rear glass, now with a full-width LED light bar, a triple-screen dashboard and turbo-petrol and diesel engines.

name: Baleno
tagline: India's favourite premium hatchback.
description: The Baleno pairs a roomy cabin with a 1.2-litre DualJet petrol, a 9-inch touchscreen, a head-up display and 360-degree camera at a price that keeps it on every shortlist.

name: Glanza
tagline: Baleno underneath, Toyota badge and warranty on top.
description: Built by Maruti Suzuki for Toyota, the Glanza shares the Baleno's 1.2-litre K-series engine and cabin, with its own honeycomb grille and Toyota's longer standard warranty.

name: Dzire
tagline: India's best-selling sedan, now with a 5-star safety rating.
description: The fourth-generation Dzire gets its own sharper face, a sunroof, a 1.2-litre three-cylinder Z-series engine and a 5-star Global NCAP rating.

name: City
tagline: The benchmark mid-size sedan, now with a strong hybrid.
description: Honda's fifth-generation City is long, low and roomy, with a smooth 1.5-litre i-VTEC petrol and a self-charging e:HEV hybrid that returns over 27 kmpl.

name: Brezza
tagline: The sub-4-metre SUV that started a segment.
description: The Brezza keeps its boxy, upright stance with a 1.5-litre mild-hybrid petrol, an electric sunroof, a head-up display and a dual-tone floating-roof option.

name: Fronx
tagline: A coupe-style crossover on the Baleno's platform.
description: The Fronx blends a raised, clad body with a sloping roofline and offers a punchy 1.0-litre Boosterjet turbo-petrol alongside the 1.2-litre DualJet.

name: Ertiga
tagline: Seven seats, small-car running costs.
description: The Ertiga is India's go-to people carrier: three rows, a 1.5-litre mild-hybrid petrol or factory CNG, and a flat, practical cabin.

name: Innova Hycross
tagline: The Innova goes monocoque, and hybrid.
description: The Hycross trades the old ladder frame for a car-like platform with a 2.0-litre strong hybrid, captain seats with ottomans, and a panoramic sunroof.

name: Venue
tagline: Compact, connected and city-sized.
description: The Venue packs a choice of three engines, including a 1.0-litre turbo with a 7-speed DCT, and connected-car tech into a sub-4-metre SUV.

name: i20
tagline: The sharpest-looking premium hatch in its class.
description: The i20 combines a wide, low stance and Z-shaped tail-lamps with a 1.2-litre petrol, a Bose sound system and a sunroof.

name: Seltos
tagline: Tiger-nose style and a 160 PS turbo.
description: The Seltos brings a bold tiger-nose grille, star-map LED lighting, dual 10.25-inch screens, ADAS and a 160 PS 1.5-litre turbo-petrol to the mid-size SUV class.

name: Sonet
tagline: A grown-up feature list in a sub-4-metre SUV.
description: The Sonet offers ventilated seats, a Bose system and ADAS with petrol, turbo-petrol and diesel engines in a compact, upright body.

name: Punch
tagline: A micro-SUV with a 5-star safety rating.
description: The Punch packs SUV styling, 187 mm of ground clearance and a 5-star Global NCAP rating into a footprint shorter than most hatchbacks.

name: Harrier
tagline: Land Rover-derived bones, bold Indian design.
description: Built on the OMEGARC platform derived from Land Rover's D8, the Harrier pairs a 170 PS 2.0-litre diesel with split LED headlamps, a 12.3-inch screen and a 5-star Bharat NCAP rating.

name: XUV700
tagline: Big power, big screens, seven seats.
description: The XUV700 brings a 200 PS turbo-petrol or 185 PS diesel, ADAS, twin 10.25-inch screens, flush door handles and an optional AWD diesel.

name: Scorpio-N
tagline: The 'Big Daddy of SUVs', body-on-frame and tough.
description: The Scorpio-N keeps a rugged ladder-frame chassis with a 4XPLOR four-wheel-drive option, a 2.2-litre diesel and a commanding, upright stance.

name: Hector
tagline: The 'Internet Inside' SUV with a 14-inch screen.
description: The Hector's huge chrome-studded grille and portrait 14-inch touchscreen headline a roomy cabin with a panoramic sunroof and turbo-petrol or diesel power.

name: Wagon R
tagline: The tall-boy hatch India keeps coming back to.
description: The Wagon R's upright 'tall-boy' body gives it headroom and easy entry far beyond its size, with frugal 1.0 and 1.2-litre petrols and factory CNG.

name: XEV 9e
tagline: A coupe-SUV built from the ground up as an EV.
description: The XEV 9e rides on Mahindra's INGLO electric platform with a sloping coupe roofline, a full-width light bar, a triple-screen dashboard and a 79 kWh battery good for up to 656 km on the MIDC cycle.

name: BE 6
tagline: A fighter-jet-inspired electric SUV.
description: The BE 6 is Mahindra's sharpest-looking EV: C-shaped lamps, a bonnet scoop, a jet-style cockpit with a head-up display, and up to 682 km of MIDC range from its 79 kWh pack.

name: Curvv
tagline: India's first mass-market coupe-SUV.
description: The Curvv brings a sloping coupe roofline to the mid-size SUV class, with a full-width light bar, flush door handles and a choice of turbo-petrol, diesel or the electric Curvv.ev with up to 502 km of range.

name: Virtus
tagline: A German-engineered sedan with a turbo heart.
description: Built in Pune on the MQB A0 IN platform, the Virtus pairs 1.0 and 1.5-litre TSI turbo-petrol engines with a 7-speed DSG on the GT, and carries a five-star Global NCAP rating.

name: Safari
tagline: A three-row flagship with a legendary name.
description: The Safari stretches the Land Rover-derived OmegaArc platform to seat six or seven, with a 170 PS Kryotec diesel, a panoramic sunroof, Level 2 ADAS and a five-star Bharat NCAP rating.

name: Tiago
tagline: Big-car safety in an entry-level hatchback.
description: The Tiago pairs a 1.2-litre three-cylinder Revotron with a four-star Global NCAP rating, a twin-cylinder CNG setup that keeps the boot usable, and an all-electric Tiago.ev sibling.

name: Hilux
tagline: The pickup that's famously hard to kill.
description: The Hilux brings the Fortuner's 2.8-litre diesel and a part-time 4x4 with low range and a locking rear differential to a double-cab pickup, with 700 mm of wading depth.

name: Grand Vitara
tagline: A strong-hybrid SUV that sips like a hatchback.
description: Co-developed with Toyota, the Grand Vitara offers a 1.5-litre smart-hybrid with optional AllGrip AWD, or a self-charging strong hybrid rated at almost 28 kmpl.

name: Alto K10
tagline: India's most affordable way into a new car.
description: The third-generation Alto K10 rides on the Heartect platform with the 1.0-litre K10C engine, an AGS automatic, a factory CNG option and six airbags as standard.

name: S-Presso
tagline: A mini-SUV stance at hatchback money.
description: The S-Presso sits tall with 180 mm of ground clearance and a centre-mounted instrument cluster, powered by the frugal 1.0-litre K10C Dualjet with an AGS or CNG option.

name: Celerio
tagline: Officially India's most fuel-efficient petrol car.
description: The second-generation Celerio uses the Heartect platform and the 1.0-litre K10C Dualjet with idle start-stop, rated at over 26 kmpl with the AGS automatic.

name: Atto 3
tagline: An electric crossover with a gym-inspired cabin.
description: The Atto 3 rides on BYD's e-Platform 3.0 with a Blade LFP battery of up to 60.48 kWh, a rotating 12.8-inch screen, guitar-string door pockets and a five-star Euro NCAP rating.
engine: Front PMSM motor, 49.92 / 60.48 kWh Blade battery

name: Seal
tagline: An electric sport sedan with a 650 km reach.
description: The Seal uses BYD's cell-to-body Blade battery as part of the structure, with up to 82.56 kWh, an optional dual-motor AWD setup good for 0–100 km/h in 3.8 seconds, and up to 650 km of range.
engine: Rear / dual PMSM motors, 61.44 / 82.56 kWh Blade battery

name: Compass
tagline: A trail-rated badge on a premium compact SUV.
description: Built in Ranjangaon, the Compass pairs a 170 PS 2.0-litre Multijet diesel with a 9-speed automatic and optional Jeep Active Drive 4x4, wrapped in the brand's seven-slot grille.

name: Land Cruiser 300
tagline: The go-anywhere flagship, now with a twin-turbo V6.
description: The LC300 moves to the TNGA-F ladder frame with a 3.3-litre twin-turbo V6 diesel, a 10-speed automatic, full-time 4WD with a locking centre differential and Multi-Terrain Select.

name: Cayenne Turbo GT
tagline: A Nürburgring-record SUV with a coupé roofline.
description: The Turbo GT is the most extreme Cayenne: a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8, titanium exhaust, carbon roof, lowered sport suspension and four seats, good for 0–100 km/h in 3.3 seconds.

name: X5
tagline: The original sports activity vehicle, made in Chennai.
description: The facelifted X5 adds a curved display with iDrive 8.5 and mild-hybrid inline-six petrol and diesel engines driving all four wheels through an 8-speed Steptronic.
engine: 3.0L turbo inline-6 petrol / diesel, 48V mild hybrid

name: Maybach S-Class
tagline: Chauffeur-class luxury with a reclining executive rear.
description: The Maybach stretches the S-Class wheelbase by 18 cm for business-class rear seats with calf massage, champagne flutes and an optional two-tone paint split by a hand-applied pinstripe.

name: Wrangler Rubicon
tagline: Removable doors, removable roof, unstoppable axles.
description: The Wrangler keeps solid axles front and rear, with the Rubicon adding Rock-Trac 4x4, locking differentials and a disconnecting front anti-roll bar; India gets a 270 PS 2.0-litre turbo petrol.

name: SF90 Stradale
tagline: Ferrari's first plug-in hybrid makes 1,000 cv.
description: The SF90 combines a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 with three electric motors, two on the front axle for torque vectoring, for 1,000 cv, all-wheel drive and 25 km of silent electric running.

name: Urus SE
tagline: The super SUV goes plug-in hybrid with 800 CV.
description: The Urus SE adds a 25.9 kWh battery and an electric motor to the 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 for 800 CV, 60 km of electric range and a 312 km/h top speed, even in EV mode.

name: Roma
tagline: La Nuova Dolce Vita in a front-engined 2+2.
description: The Roma is Ferrari's most elegant grand tourer: a front-mid 3.9-litre twin-turbo V8 with 620 cv, an 8-speed dual-clutch, a pair of rear occasional seats and a shark-nose grille-less face.

name: Purosangue
tagline: Four doors, four seats, and a V12.
description: Ferrari's first four-door uses a front-mid 6.5-litre naturally aspirated V12 with 725 cv, rear-hinged rear doors, four individual seats and active suspension that keeps the body flat.

name: EV9 GT-Line
tagline: A three-row electric SUV with swivel seats.
description: The EV9 is Kia's electric flagship: a boxy three-row SUV on the 800-volt E-GMP platform with a 99.8 kWh battery, dual-motor AWD, Level 2 ADAS and second-row captain chairs that swivel.

name: RS e-tron GT
tagline: A four-door electric grand tourer that sprints like a supercar.
description: Sharing its J1 platform with the Porsche Taycan, the RS e-tron GT has 800-volt architecture, a two-speed rear gearbox, quattro AWD and up to 646 PS on overboost.

name: DB12
tagline: The world's first 'Super Tourer'.
description: The DB12 drops a Mercedes-AMG-sourced 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 tuned to 680 PS into a bonded-aluminium chassis, with an electronic rear differential and a cabin finally brought up to date.

name: C-Class
tagline: A baby S-Class, assembled in Pune.
description: The W206 C-Class borrows the S-Class's portrait touchscreen and digital cockpit, with mild-hybrid 2.0-litre petrol and diesel engines and an optional AMG Line look.
